title: Domination win now fires immediately when 90% of towns are held
Read the environment only where there is one: the client crashed at import
Pinch-to-zoom on map (phone), with the same zoom limits as the scroll wheel
Let a player surrender: army disbands, towns go neutral, they stay to watch
Stacks swapping towns now take the same path and meet
Muster now caps at remaining stack space; max stack size increased to 300
When you lose a town, an arrow points to it from your view, showing its name, who took it, and income lost
Chat now has history, changelog shown beside lobby
Release notes can now be AI-rewritten for clarity
Push the release tag by name: --follow-tags skips lightweight tags
Ship a version per merge, with an in-app changelog and an unread glow
Replace the logo and favicon with the sword mark
Smoother big battles: unit counters no longer redraw their number on every hit
Give the win its own card, drop the centre notices, scale the HUD by half again
Win by holding 90% of the towns, and show the race once it is on
Cut render cost ~30x: baked unit textures, merged tilemap layers, batch-friendly depths
Fix the click that vanished after mustering, and two selection annoyances
Persist game statistics across deploys
Add games-by-IP to the admin stats, hashed and split by day and month
Rebuild the in-game HUD, and modernise the stack
